findings.text: follow-on: _live_attempt_holder duplicates the liveness read owned by reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py:868 live_worker_pid, and as a weaker copy (no _launched_on_this_host check, no _env_scan_run_pid reach) it answers None for a run whose worker was reparented away from both recorded pids, so a launch can proceed and retire a live attempt's records.

follow-on: the in-flight mark is set only by resume_plan, so the sweep's own launch path (resumption.py:1511 _resume) never sets it and two concurrent sweeps of one run are separated only by the narrow _prepare_attempt_records re-read rather than the mark plan comment c-s3-double-sweep-resume-1013 asked to cover that path with.

follow-on: launch_in_flight treats a mark whose pid equals the current process as no refusal, so two resumes of one run inside a single long-lived process (an in-harness MCP server, a thread pool) are not separated by the mark.

follow-on: the commit carries unrelated ruff-format reflows (blank-line removal here, and the last= and elif rewraps at :1219 and :2968) that the goal does not imply, adding diff noise to an in-scope file.

item_verdicts.diff: read 4cf6dd160 against base 65e6c32a6; three commits across six files, all inside the declared scope, adding the in-flight mark and the live-attempt refusal, the refused-advice store and delivery, and the _prepare_attempt_records live-holder guard.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when extends tests/test_resume_refuses_a_live_worker.py and tests/test_resume_sweep_needs_an_observed_death.py with the four named cases plus the advice-delivery and record-retirement cases; the manifest records them passing and records the importer-population head and base arms.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to make crew resume refuse, inside resume_plan's own check, a resume of a run whose current attempt is alive, storing the refused advice for that attempt's next resume; reckon/crew/resumption.py:210 composes the refusal and dispatch_sessions.py:1043 calls it from resume_plan.
item_verdicts.manifest: read r-20261014T080250692824/manifest.md; it records commits a78371282, 465b015df and 4cf6dd160, the importer-population head and base logs with their failure counts, the negative-control log path and note, and the live nova reproduction it was repaired against.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the source node's dispatched paths plus reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py, granted by the coordinator's resume advice with crew widen; every path in the diff is inside them.

justifications.durability: the negative-control log reddens test_a_resume_while_a_launch_is_in_flight_starts_nothing_and_keeps_its_advice on its own assertion once launch_in_flight answers nothing, so the guard is shown to fire, though several added assertions echo a pid or advice the test itself wrote.
justifications.evidence: the head gate log records 3 failed/1060 passed against base 4 failed/1055 passed, whose arithmetic leaves one head-only failure (tests/test_stored_phase_advances.py::test_stored_phase_advances_from_starting_to_working_to_complete) that the manifest attributes to -n 8 flakiness and that I re-ran three times serially at 5 passed each.
justifications.fit: the new helpers follow resumption.py's module-local idiom and carry no plan or ticket label, though dispatch_launch.py:1561 reaches into the private recovery_liveness._worker_record_liveness.
justifications.goal_fidelity: dispatch_sessions.py:1043 refuses inside resume_plan's own check and resumption.py:210 stores and names the advice, but the in-flight mark is set only by resume_plan, so the sweep's own launch path at resumption.py:1511 does not close the window plan comment c-s3-double-sweep-resume-1013 required covered.
justifications.reuse: dispatch_launch.py:1561 _live_attempt_holder re-composes the pointer-then-worker-record liveness read that reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py:868 live_worker_pid and :809 local_liveness already own, without extending either.
justifications.scope_discipline: every changed path is inside the declared write paths including the crew widen grant of dispatch_launch.py, but the commit carries unrelated ruff-format reflows at dispatch_launch.py:64 and :1219.
